title: SEA-AD cohort donor metadata
notes: Demographic, clinical, cognitive and neuropathological data per donor.

title: Ante-mortem imaging availability
notes: Counts of available ante-mortem scans per donor; the scans themselves are requested from ACT / UW ADRC.

title: Luminex Abeta and tau (MTG tissue extractions)
notes: Abeta and tau measured in MTG tissue extractions.

title: Quantitative neuropathology summary (all regions)
notes: Abeta, pTau, pTDP43, alpha-synuclein, NeuN+, IBA1+, GFAP+ measurements from stained images; updated June 2026.

title: Continuous pseudoprogression scores (global and local)
notes: Pathology burden scores derived from quantitative neuropathology.

title: Harmonized cognitive scores
notes: Memory, executive, language and visuospatial composites per visit, co-calibrated across ACT, ADNI, ROS, MAP and PITT.
